items.title: On Holding stock soaring on growth forecasts in new sports categories
items.summary: Shares of athletic apparel brand On Holding (ONON) are soaring in Tuesday's pre-market trading coming off the company's investor day. The 8:30 Hosts Julie Hyman, Pras Subramanian, and Jake Conley assess On's latest forecasts as it pushes into other sports, like golf and football.
